summary: Sole lead developer on two live production systems serving 200+ institutions. I build things that handle real load, real users, and real consequences; then I make them beautiful.

about.headline: Two production systems. One developer. 200+ institutions depending on both.
about.callout: The kind of engineer who inherits a legacy system on Monday and is shipping meaningful improvements by Friday, without hand-holding.
body: At IOSYSTEMS, I became the sole developer on two production systems — a nationwide library management platform used by 200+ institutions and a full agricultural logistics suite with RFID/IoT integrations, geospatial mapping, and two Flutter mobile apps I built from scratch.
I work directly with clients, translate ambiguous requirements into clean architecture, and deliver across the full stack without needing the problem pre-solved for me.
Outside of client work, I build portfolio projects to push my frontend ceiling: GPU-accelerated audio visualisers, AI-powered job matching platforms, and cinematic UI experiments.

RFID/IoT integrations.note: Utilizing LLRP protocols and low-latency socket connections for real-time livestock tracking.

GPU-accelerated.note: Custom GLSL shaders bypassing React reconciliation for 60fps visual performance.

experience.description: Sole developer on two inherited production systems — a nationwide library management platform (200+ institutions) and a full agricultural logistics suite.
highlights: Built two Flutter mobile apps from scratch: livestock RFID tracking, inventory, field ops, and client data viewing.
Developed a geospatial mapping app using PostGIS and .NET, rendering South African Surveyor General polygon data.
Designed and maintained RESTful APIs across PostgreSQL, MSSQL, and PostGIS.
Engaged directly with clients to gather requirements; maintained CI/CD pipelines throughout.

PostGIS.note: Optimizing spatial queries for thousands of SG polygon datasets using GiST indexing.

experience.description: Led a full rebuild of the corporate website in Next.js and TypeScript, replacing a legacy codebase.
highlights: Built a Python-based AI chatbot to automate internal information queries.
Delivered Power BI dashboards consuming internal and external data sources.
Bridged communication between non-technical teams and development deliverables.

projects.name: Waveform
projects.tagline: GPU-accelerated music visualiser and discovery app.
projects.description: Zero-allocation 60fps audio pipeline bypassing React's component lifecycle entirely. Custom GLSL vertex and fragment shaders drive real-time 3D geometry morphing from live frequency data. Hybrid beat detection, D3.js force-directed genre graph, and dynamic album-art colour extraction.

projects.name: JobHunter
projects.tagline: AI-powered job matching platform — full stack, production deployed.
projects.description: Aggregates live listings from multiple job APIs, scores each role against a parsed CV using LLM inference (Groq / LLaMA 3.3 70B), generates context-aware cover letters, and tracks the full application pipeline. Behavioural calibration layer adjusts future scoring based on past decisions.

education.degree: Diploma in Information Technology & Software Development
education.ethos: Formal training gave me the fundamentals. Production systems gave me the judgment.
